experiment_metadata.title: Single-Agent vs. Swarm Conceptual Model Refinement: Controlled Empirical Comparison on Anneal's MIR Verification Pipeline

candidates_explored: M3 (Total Indexed Capture + Stratified Flat Stage 2 + Verified Stage 3 Lowering)
Architect Alpha (Radical Minimizer: 2-stage pipeline, BodyId flat table, Obligation.assumed)
Architect Beta (Structural Generalizer: Place/ProjectionElem, MentionedItem, stratified AdmissibleAdtInv, lowerBody)
Architect Gamma (Pragmatic Incumbent Defender: TrustedBoundary.lean audit discipline, multi-config CONFIGS analysis, two-stage ConstsTotal/MonoAdmitted)

macro_architectural_simplifications.title: Eliminating CaptureProfile and Multi-Version Capture Subcrates
macro_architectural_simplifications.description: Eliminate the 3-tuple CaptureProfile = (schema_version, rustc_version, SemProfile) and multi-version subcrate hierarchy (rustc-capture-v1_85/, v1_86/) in favor of one pinned toolchain (toolchain-manifest.json) and a single parameterized Crate.layout : LayoutEnv record.
macro_architectural_simplifications.single_agent_m3_prime: Converged: replaced CaptureProfile and versioned subcrates with a single rustc-capture crate and TargetLayout record (pass1-analysis.md:178-183, pass2-final-design.md:9-19).
macro_architectural_simplifications.swarm_candidate_003: Converged: replaced CaptureProfile and versioned subcrates with a single rustc-capture binary and LayoutEnv = { ptrBits, maxTypeSize } (final-design.md:27-35, 92-104).

macro_architectural_simplifications.title: Removing Dead TargetSem, TargetArtifact, TargetLang, and rustcCodec Scaffolding
macro_architectural_simplifications.description: Remove the 5 unprovable target-compilation definitions (TargetArtifact, rustc, opaque TargetSem, TargetLang, rustcCodec) that existed solely to state an always-waived Obligation.compiles, replacing them with a primitive Obligation.assumed item constructor.
macro_architectural_simplifications.single_agent_m3_prime: Converged: replaced Obligation.compiles + TargetSem/TargetArtifact/TargetLang/rustcCodec with Obligation.assumed (id : TCBItem) (pass1-analysis.md:191-194, pass2-final-design.md:111-116).
macro_architectural_simplifications.swarm_candidate_003: Converged: replaced Obligation.compiles + TargetSem/TargetArtifact/TargetLang/rustcCodec with Obligation.assumed (item : TCBItem) and TCBItem.rustcLowering (fn : FnId) (body : BodyId) (final-design.md:72-90, 622-655).

macro_architectural_simplifications.title: Removing MirBody from TCBItem and Breaking the Terminator/MirBody Mutual Induction via BodyId Tables
macro_architectural_simplifications.description: Replace recursive MirBody values inside Terminator.call, Rvalue.constBlock, and TCBItem with flat BodyId indices into Crate.bodies : List BodyDecl, breaking the mutual inductive cycle and eliminating the 200-line fuel-bounded beqMirBodyFuel 8 comparator.
macro_architectural_simplifications.single_agent_m3_prime: Converged on flat BodyId table and TCBItem.rustcLowering String BodyId (pass1-analysis.md:195-204, pass2-final-design.md:45-62).
macro_architectural_simplifications.swarm_candidate_003: Converged on flat BodyId table (Crate.bodies : List BodyDecl) and TCBItem.rustcLowering FnId BodyId with structural beqCrate (final-design.md:92-198, 622-635).

macro_architectural_simplifications.title: Replacing the 9-Entry Whole-Crate beqCrate Lookup Table with Compositional Stage 3 Lowering
macro_architectural_simplifications.description: Replace the brittle 9-shape whole-crate lookup table (proveCrateOpt) with compositional per-function verification and a verified Stage 3 MIR-to-MIR cleanup pass (lowerBody + lowerBody_simulates).
macro_architectural_simplifications.single_agent_m3_prime: Converged on replacing the 9-entry table with Stage 3 lowerBody : MirBody -> MirBody and lowerBody_simulates (pass1-analysis.md:208-219, pass2-final-design.md:154-174).
macro_architectural_simplifications.swarm_candidate_003: Converged on compositional per-function verification and in-place Stage 3 lowerBody with block-entry backward simulation lowerBody_simulates (final-design.md:880-955).

macro_architectural_simplifications.title: First-Order Trusted Specification ASTs, Static 8-Line Proof.lean, and Demand-Driven .unsupported Capture
macro_architectural_simplifications.description: Emit contract and invariant specifications as first-order ASTs inside Mir.lean (Trusted.Crate) rather than generating per-crate theorem statements in Proof.lean, keep Proof.lean a static 8-line file, and translate unrecognized MIR constructs to syntax-total .unsupported nodes that step to .failed on demand.
macro_architectural_simplifications.single_agent_m3_prime: Converged on first-order Trusted/Spec.lean ASTs, static 8-line Proof.lean, and syntax-total .unsupported constructors (pass1-analysis.md:220-232, pass2-final-design.md:83-109, 176-188).
macro_architectural_simplifications.swarm_candidate_003: Converged on first-order SpecExpr/InvariantSpec/RequiresSpec/PostSpec in MirAst.lean, static 8-line Proof.lean, and syntax-total .unsupported nodes stepping to .failed (final-design.md:145-198, 560-620).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Baseline extract.rs Partial-Move Bug and Single-Agent Omission of Partial-Move Deinitialization
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' generalized Rvalue.field0 to Rvalue.field (src : LocalId) (fieldIdx : Nat) (pass1-analysis.md:327) without Place projections or MirVal.uninit leaves, preserving non-destructive field extraction on Operand::Move(_1.0).

swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 0 (Architect Beta + Discovery D5 + Holdout H1)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: partial-overcorrection (introduced Place + MirVal.uninit + updateProj, but failed to guard whole-aggregate reads in evalProjFuel; see D-02)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: mostly-resolved (guarded direct whole-aggregate reads via isFullyInitFuel, leaving intermediate .deref hop; see D-03)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: struct Pair(NonCopy, NonCopy); let _a = move (_1.0); let _b = move (_1.0); // In baseline extract.rs:474-480, both Move(_1.0) lower to Rvalue.field0 1, leaving _1 initialized so the illegal second move of _1.0 succeeds instead of stepping to .failed.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: Baseline extract.rs rewrote both Operand::Copy(_1.0) and Operand::Move(_1.0) into Rvalue::Field0(1), and evalMirStmt for .assign dst (.field0 src) never updated src. Single-agent M3' kept flat local-indexed Rvalue.field without sub-place deinitialization.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Represent places as Place = { local : LocalId, proj : List ProjElem }, represent uninitialized leaves via MirVal.uninit inside MirVal.adt / MirVal.tuple, and have evalOperand (.move srcPlace) write MirVal.uninit to the moved sub-place via writePlace s srcPlace .uninit.

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Swarm Pass-1 Partial-Move Over-Correction / Unchecked Whole-Aggregate Read After Partial Move
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' never introduced Place projections or partial-move deinitialization (pass2-final-design.md:21-43), so it never reached sub-tree initialization checks.

swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (evalProjFuel and resolveRefTargetFuel only rejected .uninit at top level, allowing Copy(_1), Move(_1), PlaceMention(_1), or &_1 when _1 = .adt id [.uninit, v1])
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: resolved for direct reads via recursive isFullyInitFuel (depthFuel c) v

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: let _a = move (_1.0); let _whole = move _1; // After moving _1.0, _1 holds .adt id [.uninit, .usize 9]. Reading sibling _1.1 is valid, but reading or borrowing whole _1 must step to .failed.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: When Candidate 001 replaced whole-local deinitialization (which would have broken sibling _1.1 reads) with leaf-level MirVal.uninit inside MirVal.adt, its terminal [] arm of evalProjFuel returned some v without checking whether nested fields of v contained .uninit, and Rvalue.ref / Stmt.placeMention only called resolveRefTarget.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Define total fuel-bounded MirVal.isFullyInitFuel (depthFuel c) v that recursively checks all .adt and .tuple children for .uninit, enforce it at the terminal [] arm of evalProjFuel, and require evalPlace c s place = some _ in both Rvalue.ref and Stmt.placeMention.

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Intermediate .deref Hop on Partially-Moved Struct and Rvalue.ref Borrow Bypass
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' had no Place projection evaluator or multi-step .deref projection chain (pass2-final-design.md:21-43).

swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (no recursive initialization check at all)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: defective (evalProjFuel .deref :: rest concatenated targetProj ++ rest, checking isFullyInitFuel only at the final leaf _1.1 rather than the dereferenced intermediate aggregate _1)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: let r = &_1; let _a = move (_1.0); let _x = (*r).1; // When r holds .ref 0 gen (LocalId.mk 1) [], evaluating (*r).1 concatenated [] ++ [.field 1] = [.field 1] on _1, bypassing the requirement that the dereferenced reference target *r itself be a fully initialized aggregate.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: In Candidate 002, the .deref :: rest arm of evalProjFuel jumped directly to evalProjFuel c s fuel rootVal (targetProj ++ rest), so isFullyInitFuel was only tested on the final projected field rather than on the intermediate dereferenced referent targetVal.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: In the .deref :: rest arm of evalProjFuel, first evaluate evalProjFuel c s fuel rootVal targetProj to some targetVal (which runs isFullyInitFuel on targetVal at the end of targetProj), and only then evaluate rest on targetVal.

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Polymorphic Dead-Branch PME Hole (Body::mentioned_items) and Two-Stage ConstsTotal vs. MonoAdmitted
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' both missed Body::mentioned_items (failing to capture dead-branch PME items erased from basic_blocks and required_consts) and collapsed Baseline's two-stage ConstsTotal + MonoAdmitted into a single-stage ConstsEvaluated predicate (pass2-final-design.md:31-35).

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 0 (baseline extract.rs missed mentioned_items; Candidate 001 collapsed ConstsTotal + MonoAdmitted)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 0 (Architect Beta + D8/H5) and Pass 1 Falsification (Challenger 1 F1.3 + Stitcher H3/S2 + Fresh Critic 001 C2)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (added MentionedItem capture, but collapsed ConstsTotal and MonoAdmitted into a single universal ExecNormal predicate over all tySizes, making every conditional PME guard const { assert!(size_of::<T>() == 8) } unverifiable)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: partially-repaired (restored two-stage ConstsTotal + MonoAdmitted, but introduced vacuous implication in ConstsTotal; see D-05)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: pub fn dead_branch_pme<T>() { if false { let _ = Fail::<T>::C; } } // SimplifyConstCondition + RemoveDeadBlocks erase the dead block and drain Body::required_consts before Runtime(PostCleanup), leaving Fail::<T>::C only in Body::mentioned_items.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: rustc's SimplifyConstCondition and RemoveDeadBlocks passes remove dead blocks and unused required_consts entries before PostCleanup MIR, recording surviving type-check obligations in Body::mentioned_items. Furthermore, conditional PME guards unwind under invalid tySizes and succeed under valid tySizes, requiring two-stage ConstsTotal (succeeds OR unwinds for all ValidTySizes) + MonoAdmitted (succeeds at active s.tySizes).
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Extract both Body::required_consts and Body::mentioned_items into BodyDecl.mentionedItems : List MentionedItem, and enforce both ConstsTotal c body (every transitive mentioned const either ConstSucceeds or ConstUnwinds across all ValidTySizes) and MonoAdmitted c s.tySizes body (every transitive mentioned const ConstSucceeds and MentionedItem.tyLayout has a valid layout at active s.tySizes).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Vacuous ConstsTotal Implication on Unsized/Unsupported Types and Empty Generic Substitution in Pass 2
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' used single-stage ConstsEvaluated without generic type-argument substitution or layout totality checks (pass2-final-design.md:31-35).

swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: defective (ConstsTotal used universal implication mapOpt (evalTyByteSize ...) = some argSizes -> ... and called instantiateBody c cid [] with empty type arguments)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: MentionedItem.constItem cid [.unsupported] // Because evalTyByteSize c tySizes .unsupported = none, the antecedent mapOpt (evalTyByteSize c tySizes) typeArgs = some argSizes is false, making the implication in Candidate 002's ConstsTotal vacuously True! And for any generic const with typeParamCount = 1, instantiateBody c cid [] returned none.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: In Candidate 002, the synthesizer wrote ConstsTotal with mapOpt (evalTyByteSize c tySizes) typeArgs = some argSizes on the left-hand side of an implication (->) instead of a positive existential conjunction (exists argSizes, ... /\ ...), and hardcoded [] instead of typeArgs in instantiateBody c cid [].
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Define ConstsTotal using positive existential quantification in both arms (.constItem cid typeArgs requires exists argSizes constBody, mapOpt (evalTyByteSize c tySizes) typeArgs = some argSizes /\ instantiateBody c cid typeArgs = some constBody /\ (ConstSucceeds ... \/ ConstUnwinds ...); .tyLayout ty requires exists sz, evalTyByteSize c tySizes ty = some sz) and close ReachableMentioned transitively over mentioned items of referenced constants.

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Unconstrained tySizes Exceeding isize::MAX and Unbounded MirVal.usize Inputs Exceeding usize::MAX
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' quantified over unconstrained (tySizes : Nat -> Nat) and defined MirVal.usize without bounding values by 2^ptrBits - 1 in validStep or ValidTySizes (pass2-final-design.md:31-39).

swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 0 / Pass 1 (Architect Alpha, Architect Beta, D8, H9, R1)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: partial (bounded MirVal.usize and LayoutEnv, but used 2 ^ ... exponentiation rejected by TrustedBoundary.lean; see D-10)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean: pub fn size_check<T>() -> usize { core::mem::size_of::<T>() + 0 } // Without ValidTySizes (tySizes idx <= isize::MAX), tySizes 0 = 2^64 causes size_of::<T>() to exceed usize::MAX even though rustc rejects any monomorphization whose layout size exceeds isize::MAX.
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: Baseline MirSemantics.lean modeled MirVal.usize as an unbounded Nat in validStep (| .usize, .usize _ => True) and quantified over arbitrary Nat -> Nat in ConstsTotal and initMirState without bounding type sizes by rustc's Layout::from_size_align_unchecked invariant (size <= isize::MAX).
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Record Explicit integer bounds in LayoutEnv (ptrBits = 64, maxTypeSize = 9223372036854775807) without exponentiation, enforce val <= c.layout.usizeMax in validStep for .usize, and constrain both ConstsTotal and initMirState by ValidTySizes c tySizes (forall idx, tySizes idx <= c.layout.maxTypeSize).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: AdmissibleAdtInv defaultAdtInv Failure on Nested Structs and Pass-1 Omission of FieldAccess
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' retained baseline AdmissibleAdtInv checking fields under defaultAdtInv (pass2-final-design.md:94-103), which fails whenever a public struct wraps a private-field ADT with a non-trivial invariant.

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 0 (baseline MirSemantics.lean:1005) and Pass 1 (Candidate 001 dropped FieldAccess and InvariantSpec)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 0 (Architect Beta + D7/H4) and Pass 1 Falsification (Challenger 2 F2.2 + Stitcher S1b + Fresh Critic 001 C1)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (dropped FieldAccess and InvariantSpec from AdtDecl, breaking NonZero representation invariant enforcement)

defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: Baseline AdmissibleAdtInv evaluated field validity using defaultAdtInv (which strips invariants from all nested ADTs, even those with private fields that safe callers cannot forge). Then Candidate 001 over-simplified AdtDecl by dropping FieldAccess and InvariantSpec altogether.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Restore FieldAccess (.pubSafe | .restricted) and InvariantSpec on AdtDecl, and define stratified AdmissibleAdtInv: for any struct where allFieldsPubSafe = true, any field vector fieldVals whose elements each satisfy the full crate invariant validFuel c adtInv s 0 0 (depthFuel c) must satisfy adtInv decl.id (.adt decl.id fieldVals).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Compiler-Inserted TerminatorKind::Assert Stepping to .unwind Instead of .failed (Masking Overflow UB)
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' neither modeled Terminator.assert nor distinguished compiler-inserted overflow assertions from user panic calls across debug/release profiles (pass2-final-design.md:21-43).

swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: stepped Terminator.assert failure to .failed, but lacked two-stage ConstUnwinds distinction for Callee.panic
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: defective (changed Terminator.assert failure to step to .terminated .unwind to appease H3, which allowed arithmetic overflow in bad_overflow to verify as safe unwind instead of .failed UB)

defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: In Pass 2, to make const { assert!(size_of::<T>() == 8); } step to .terminated .unwind under H3, the synthesizer changed Terminator.assert failure from .failed to .terminated .unwind. However, rustc lowers user assert!(...) to SwitchInt + core::panicking::panic (Callee.panic), whereas TerminatorKind::Assert is emitted for compiler-inserted arithmetic overflow, bounds, and division-by-zero checks that may be elided in release builds.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Step Terminator.assert failure strictly to .failed (so any unguarded arithmetic overflow, division by zero, or bounds check failure is a verification failure), while stepping Callee.panic to .terminated .unwind (so explicit user panics and const { assert!(...) } blocks unwind cleanly).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Cross-Config -C overflow-checks MIR Divergence and #[cfg(debug_assertions)] LocalDefId Index Shifting
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' retained baseline CONFIGS with differing overflow_checks and keyed BodyId directly by raw rustc LocalDefId.local_def_index (pass1-analysis.md:201, pass2-final-design.md:48), which shifts whenever #[cfg(debug_assertions)] introduces a helper item.

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 0 (baseline main.rs:325-328) and Pass 1 (Candidate 001 raw LocalDefId indexing)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 1 Falsification (Challenger 2 F2.4 + Fresh Critic 001 C7) and Pass 2 Falsification (Fresh Critic 002 FC2-5)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (used raw LocalDefId index as BodyId and kept mismatched overflow-checks in CONFIGS)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: partial (replaced raw LocalDefId with dense reachability-interned BodyId, but still varied -C overflow-checks across CONFIGS)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean:
pub fn add_one(x: usize) -> usize { x + 1 }
// Under baseline CONFIGS: debug (-Coverflow-checks=on) emits Rvalue::BinaryOp(AddWithOverflow) returning (usize, bool) + TerminatorKind::Assert; release (-Coverflow-checks=off) emits Rvalue::BinaryOp(Add) returning usize. Requiring byte-identical Mir.lean across both rejects every crate containing +, -, or *!
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: Baseline main.rs varied both debug_assertions and overflow_checks across CONFIGS while requiring identical PostCleanup MIR. Because checked arithmetic changes MIR statement/terminator shapes (and requires MirTy.tuple / MirVal.tuple for (T, bool)) while #[cfg(debug_assertions)] shifts raw LocalDefId numbers, every arithmetic crate or debug-only item caused spurious capture failure.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Pin -C overflow-checks=on and -Z mir-preserve-ub in both CONFIGS passes (varying only -C debug-assertions=on vs off to reject cfg-dependent divergence in verified items), add MirTy.tuple and MirVal.tuple for CheckedBinOp outputs, and assign dense 0-based BodyId/AdtId/SpanId in deterministic pre-order reachability traversal from Crate.fns.

defect_discovery_matrix.title: TrustedBoundary.lean Syntax Whitelist and foundation-lock.json Import Rejections
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' assumed BEq/DecidableEq could be derived on MirBody once the mutual cycle was broken (pass1-analysis.md:195) and used standard arithmetic syntax without auditing TrustedBoundary.lean's closed allowlists allowedCommandSyntaxKinds and allowedNotationSyntaxKinds.

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 1 (Candidate 001 used import Init.Data.String.Basic, unary -Int.ofNat, and 2 ^ ...)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 1 Falsification (Challenger 2 F2.1 + Stitcher H6/S6 + Fresh Critic 001 C8/C10) and Pass 3 Polish (Fresh Critic 003 Section 1.2 item 1 caught x notin xs)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (used import Init.Data.String.Basic, unary negation -Int.ofNat, and exponentiation 2 ^ ...)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: resolved (removed Init.Data.String.Basic, unary -, and ^; NoDupIds x notin xs polished in Pass 3)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean:
-- In SourceRole.trusted (trusted/lean/Trusted/*.lean):
import Init.Data.String.Basic -- rejected by foundation-lock.json transitive .olean module check
deriving DecidableEq, Repr -- excluded from allowedCommandSyntaxKinds (derivingClass, line 218)
-(Int.ofNat n), 2 ^ 64, x ∉ xs -- excluded from allowedNotationSyntaxKinds (lines 274-280)
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: TrustedBoundary.lean enforces closed syntax and .olean environment allowlists on SourceRole.trusted: derivingClass is excluded from allowedCommandSyntaxKinds (line 218), and unary negation, exponentiation, and not-in notation are excluded from allowedNotationSyntaxKinds (lines 274-280) to prevent macro-expansion and typeclass synthesis surprises inside the TCB.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Import only Init.Core, Init.Data.List.Basic, and Init.Data.Option.Basic; replace String identifiers with Interned Idx wrappers (FnId, AdtId, BodyId, SpanId); write explicit structural BEq functions in theory/; represent signed integers via Sign = .pos | .neg; store precomputed maxTypeSize = 9223372036854775807; and write NoDupIds using (x in xs -> False).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Frame-Relative returnRefsOk and resolveLocal Bounds Across Nested Callee Returns
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' left returnRefsOk and resolveRef unspecified at nested call boundaries while proposing to generalize Place projections (pass2-final-design.md:21-43).

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 1 (Candidate 001 resolveRefLocal bound bug) and Pass 2 (Candidate 002 targetFrameId = 0 hardcoding in returnRefsOk)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 1 Falsification (F1.2, C5, H2/S3) and Pass 2 Falsification (P2.2, FC2-2, H2)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (resolveRefLocal passed activeBody.localCount as bound, rejecting caller-owned synthetic locals at root.index >= activeBody.localCount)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: defective (removed localCount bound from resolveLocal, but defined returnRefsOk as a Prop instead of Bool and hardcoded targetFrameId = 0 /\ b.localCount <= root.index, rejecting nested helpers fn id_ref(r: &usize) -> &usize { r } when caller local has root.index = 1 < b.localCount)

defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: At root return (s.frameId = 0), a returned reference must point to an external caller-owned synthetic referent (targetFrameId = 0 and root.index >= rootBody.localCount). At a nested callee return (s.frameId > 0), however, a valid returned reference may point to any strictly older activation frame (targetFrameId < s.frameId), including the caller's own local variables (0 < root.index < callerBody.localCount).
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: Define MirVal.returnRefsOk as a total computable Bool that checks targetFrameId == 0 && decide (localCount <= root.index) when s.frameId == 0, and decide (targetFrameId < s.frameId) when s.frameId > 0 (preventing escaping references to the dying callee frame s.frameId while allowing references to any caller frame).

defect_discovery_matrix.title: Root Terminator.return_ PC-Canonicalization in MirReturn.state and In-Place Stage 3 lowerBody Simulation
defect_discovery_matrix.single_agent_evidence: Single-agent M3' proposed Stage 3 lowerBody coalescing trivial goto chains and stripping Stmt.nop / StorageLive / StorageDead (pass1-analysis.md:211-218, pass2-final-design.md:154-174) while leaving root Terminator.return_ returning raw ⟨retVal, s⟩, which makes lowerBody_simulates mathematically unprovable because s.block, s.stmtIdx, s.curBody, and s.localGens differ in MirReturn.state.

swarm_lifecycle.pass_introduced: Pass 1 (Candidate 001 proposed lowerBody stripping nop/storageLive/storageDead and coalescing blocks without canonicalizing MirReturn.state)
swarm_lifecycle.pass_caught: Pass 1 Falsification (Challenger 2 F2.3, Challenger 3 F3.1, Stitcher H8/S5, Fresh Critic 001 C9) and Pass 2 Falsification (Fresh Critic 002 FC2-4)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_001_state: defective (lowerBody stripped storageLive/storageDead and changed stmtIdx at return while MirReturn.state exposed raw s)
swarm_lifecycle.candidate_002_state: mostly-resolved (canonicalized block := 0, stmtIdx := 0, curBody := none at root return and kept storageLive/storageDead, but stated lowerBody_simulates for arbitrary mid-block states s where s.stmtIdx is out of bounds in lowered block)

defect_discovery_matrix.counterexample_rust_or_lean:
-- Block 0 in raw body b: [Stmt.nop] + Terminator.return_
-- Block 0 in lowerBody b: [] + Terminator.return_
-- Without PC-canonicalization at root return, b terminates with r.state.stmtIdx = 1 whereas lowerBody b terminates with r.state.stmtIdx = 0, falsifying ExecNormal c (lowerBody b) s P -> ExecNormal c b s P for any postcondition P inspecting MirReturn.state!
defect_discovery_matrix.root_cause: EnsuresRetLibInv evaluates r.value.valid c adtInv r.state on the terminal MirReturn.state, which only inspects frame-0 locals and localGens above localCount, but raw MirReturn.mk retVal s also embeds control-flow coordinates (s.block, s.stmtIdx, s.curBody). Any Stage 3 pass that removes Stmt.nop or short-circuits goto chains alters (s.block, s.stmtIdx) at root return unless root Terminator.return_ canonicalizes those fields.
defect_discovery_matrix.verified_resolution_in_candidate_003: At root Terminator.return_ (s.stack = []), emit .terminated (.normal ⟨retVal, { s with block := 0, stmtIdx := 0, curBody := none }⟩); keep Stmt.storageLive and Stmt.storageDead intact in lowerBody so s.localGens stays identical; preserve b.blocks.length via in-place block updates; and state lowerBody_simulates with block-entry precondition hEntry : s.stmtIdx = 0 /\ s.curBody = none.

primary_contributions: Eliminated CaptureProfile and multi-version subcrate hierarchy (M-1)
Replaced embedded MirBody in TCBItem and Terminator with flat BodyId table (M-3)
